name: crossdrop-monorepo
description: CrossDrop - Phase 1 Cross-Device File Sharing Web App

scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
